title: The Horrifying Case of Harmony Montgomery
description:
When police realized Harmony Montgomery hadn't been seen in two years, they began to search for the last person she was with, her father Adam Montgomery. Adam told a variety of stories about where she was, and confirmed she was alive. A different version of events would tell the horrifying truth.
